day_shape: 63 items: Oman postpones Iran–Gulf Hormuz talks at Saudi request, CENTCOM says US blockade has redirected 101 vessels, Iran claims IRGC downed an MQ-1 over Hormuz, downed US F-15 aircrew give first account, nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: Hormuz talks postponed, shipping pressure
threads.summary: Iran's foreign ministry spokesman Baghaei confirmed Saudi Arabia requested postponement of the Muscat meeting of Persian Gulf littoral states, with no new date set. Iran International reported a deadly strike on an Iranian container ship killed one crew member, while Tehran ruled out reopening the strait.

threads.label: US blockade and Hormuz air incidents
threads.summary: CENTCOM said US forces have redirected 101 commercial vessels enforcing the blockade against Iran as of 13 September, and Admiral Brad Cooper met Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman on Monday. Defa Press claimed the IRGC intercepted and destroyed an MQ-1 drone over the Strait of Hormuz, and the PGSA updated its non-compliant vessels list.

threads.label: Downed F-15 aftermath and Iranian claims
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post carried a US airman's account of surviving a failed parachute and Iranian manhunt after the F-15 was shot down, while CNN reported Hegseth pressured the pilots to appear on 60 Minutes. IRIB and Defa Press repost images they claim show F-15E "DUDE 44" wreckage from RAF Lakenheath, and the FM spokesman said Iran had seized a US submarine as war booty.

threads.label: Yemen, Red Sea and Saudi airbase claims
threads.summary: Defa Press claimed Yemeni forces struck Malik Khaled airbase at Khamis Mushayt with dozens of missiles and said Ansarullah's control of Bab al-Mandab shifts the regional balance. Jerusalem Post analysis said the Houthi capture of Yemen's Red Sea coastline is reshaping the Gulf balance and strengthening Iran's hand.

threads.label: Iran economy and IAEA friction
threads.summary: Iran International reported foreign investment in Iran has fallen to zero this Iranian year and that Iranians describe basic food slipping beyond reach as bread prices rise. IRIB carried the Tehran stock index down 38,000 units to 7.393 million and said US pressure prevented AEOI chief Eslami from attending the IAEA conference in Vienna.

threads.label: Israel operations in West Bank, Gaza, Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF said it apprehended a planner of an imminent shooting attack in Judea and Samaria and killed two Hamas engineering-unit operatives, Hassan Ali Abu Nada and Abd al-Rahim Ahmad Khalil Khawa, in a Gaza City strike. Defense Minister Israel Katz warned anyone approaching the Ali Taher Ridge would be destroyed after the IDF demolished Hezbollah tunnels there.

threads.label: Iran judiciary, executions and protest cases
threads.summary: Iran International reported at least eight women face death sentences, including four linked to the January protests, and that a court sentenced a January protest detainee in Shandiz to death. Judiciary head Ayatollah Azehi said fighting corruption was the priority and Defa Press said 240 items of property linked to "traitors" and the "Zionist regime" had been seized.
